snippet.title: American Truck Simulator - 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Discover the legendary roads of the USA in American Truck Simulator. Drive iconic, licensed trucks and explore a growing world of diverse landscapes, industries, and cities. Build your own trucking company, haul a wide range of cargo, and enjoy immersive gameplay, whether you travel solo or with friends in Convoy multiplayer.

New to the road? Our in-game Driving Academy offers the perfect place to learn the basics, improve your skills, and get comfortable behind the wheel before heading out on your journey.

Start your trucking adventure today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/

http://americantrucksimulator.com/
